title: Note: worktree pool stuck — minion/task-mastermind spawns waiting 15+ min for a ready worktree

chat.text: Six real spawns (5 Haiku/Sonnet proving-ground questions + 1 ask-audit judging batch) from mastermind-cheap-models have sat queued 15+ minutes with reason "waits for a pool worktree" — system_health shows 7 worktrees in state "pool" (should be recyclable) and 1 "in use", yet nothing is being handed out. This matches the still-open ask "Servex: worktree pool stuck (qf-6, qf-9 held 17h by finished agents)" in asks.jsonl — likely the same root cause recurring. Separately, known-answer.mjs's own spawn_agent calls with role:"task-mastermind" intermittently fail with "Bad log name" for agent ids over roughly 80 characters (the same exact name format sometimes succeeds, sometimes doesn't) — a Servex log-name-length bug, not a model problem. Routing to mastermind-servex for the pool issue; noted in this task's rules.md.

Two bugs block spawns. First: worktree pool starvation — seven worktrees sit in state "pool" but none get handed out, matching the still-open ask in /framework/ai/asks.jsonl.
